decision_rule: §8 gate per candidate: eligible iff its paired validation Δ̄_lin vs G* (H1/M0, the W1 look's G-star) has CI lower bound > 0 (L_prob, all genes, U, no stratum). Among eligible candidates the paired-difference one-SE rule (§9) picks the first candidate in spec order (D10, simplest first: (1) H1+B-loo/M0, (2) H1/M2(f=1), (3) H1+B-loo/M2(f=1)) whose Δ̄_lin(best − candidate) <= its bootstrap SE; that cell is P1 (§10.1 steps 3-4, A12c). If none is eligible, P1 is the best point estimate labelled 'gate not passed'. σ·√(2 ln m) with m = 3 is reported. H2 cells are descriptive (never P1).
notes: M6 integration factorial (A12c; cells fixed in RESEARCH_TREE D10 before any factorial scoring). Context lever not selected (M5 pre-check, A12b), so no context axis. Scores are line-specific (layout line_gene) over the 198 validation expression lines: e = 1 − ratio_r of the KO sweep of (parent, biomass variant, the line's medium); M2(f=1) = documented base medium + supplements + serum model f = 1, gate-free, as in results/w2/controls/line_sweeps.tsv (imputed / fallback / unmappable lines: W2's integrated-pipeline medium, classic RPMI + 10% FBS; onboarded lines: onboarded medium). B-loo = W3 B-loo:cofactor_pool_biomass (results/w3/structure/variants_<parent>.json). H1 and H2 columns equal the W1 generic scores. Flags carried: W3-D1 on cells (1) and (3) (no pre-registered negative control applies to biomass leave-outs; no claim may rest on 'beats controls'); W2-SHUF and W2-MOPEN on cells (2) and (3) (no line-specific-medium claim; the gain is 'realistic culture medium vs Ham's'); W3-MEV on cell (3) (under serum media the cofactor-pool B-loo makes HMGCR/MVK/PMVK/MVD non-lethal; results/m6/scores/w3_mev.tsv). Training (686 lines, 12 lineages; results/m6/train/): (1) H1+Bloo/M0: +0.0343 [+0.0336, +0.0349], 12/12, TG pass; (2) H1/M2: +0.0160 [+0.0152, +0.0168], 12/12, TG pass; (3) H1+Bloo/M2: +0.0534 [+0.0523, +0.0545], 12/12, TG pass. This single look is also W2's validation answer (D10). Harness fit: the spec's workstream 'M6' does not match the harness rule workstream == W<n> == results/<ws>/val (A11g), so the harness refuses it as is; PI decision needed (see results/m6/README.md).
